name: Ukucindezeleka
sources: SADAG (South African Depression and Anxiety Group)
National Department of Health Mental Health Directorate

urgent.heading: Khuluma nomuntu manje
urgent.primary_message: Uma ucabanga ukuzibulala, noma ukuzilimaza - sicela welule isandla. Ukwesekwa kwamahhala, okuyimfihlo kuyatholakala njengamanje. Akumele ube senkingeni ukuze ushaye ucingo.
red_flags: Imicabango yokuqeda impilo yakho noma ukuthi abanye bangaphila kangcono ngaphandle kwakho
Ukuzizwa ndikindiki ngokuphelele, ungenalutho, noma unqanyuliwe kuwena
Ukuhoxa okunzima kuwo wonke umuntu nakho konke
Ukuzwa amazwi, ukubona izinto abanye abangaziboni, noma ukuzizwa ungelona iqiniso ngokujulile
Ukungakwazi ukuzinakekela - ukungadli, ukugeza, ukuphuma embhedeni izinsuku
Ukuzola kungazelelwe ngemva kokucindezeleka isikhathi eside - lokhu kungaba yisixwayiso, hhayi ukululama

what_is_it.heading: Ukucindezeleka ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Ukucindezeleka kuyisimo sezempilo sangempela - hhayi ubuthakathaka, hhayi isimo sengqondo esibi, hhayi 'ukudabuka nje'. Ishintsha indlela ubuchopho obusebenza ngayo, indlela umzimba ozizwa ngayo, nendlela yonke into ebukeka ngayo. Futhi iyelapheka.
paragraphs: Wonke umuntu uzizwa edabukile ngezinye izikhathi. Ukucindezeleka kuhlukile. Ubuhlungu obuhlala njalo — isimo esiphansi esiqhubekayo, ukulahlekelwa isithakazelo ezintweni obukade uzijabulela, ukukhathala okungalungiseki ukulala, imizwa yokungabi nto yalutho noma yokungabi nathemba. Kuthatha amasonto noma izinyanga, hhayi amahora noma izinsuku.

Ukudangala kuthinta cishe umuntu oyedwa kwabayisi-6 baseNingizimu Afrika empilweni yakhe. Ihamba ngemindeni. Kungabangelwa ukucindezeleka, ukugula, ukulahlekelwa, ukushintsha kwama-hormone, noma lutho ngokukhethekile. Ngokwelashwa - ukwelashwa, imithi, noma kokubili - abantu abaningi baba ngcono kakhulu. Abaningi balulama ngokuphelele.

items.headline: 1 em6
items.body: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazobhekana nengcindezi empilweni yabo. Kungesinye sezimo zezokwelapha ezivame kakhulu ezikhona.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: Cishe u-80% wabantu abanokucindezeleka baba ngcono kakhulu ngokwelashwa. Abaningi balulama ngokuphelele. Usizo luyasebenza.

items.headline: I-SADAG imahhala
items.body: Inombolo ethi 0800 567 567 iyilayini yamahhala yaseNingizimu Afrika yokuzibulala - abeluleki abaqeqeshelwe ukulalela, ngezilimi eziningi, amahora angama-24.

items.headline: Hhayi ubuthakathaka
items.body: Ukucindezeleka yisimo sezokwelapha esihlanganisa izinguquko kumakhemikhali obuchopho. Ukutshela umuntu ukuthi 'aphume kukho' kufana nokutshela onesifo sikashukela ukuthi enze i-insulin ibe nzima. Akusebenzi.

pull_quote.text: Ukufinyelela usizo akubona ubuthakathaka. Kungenye yezinto ezinesibindi, ezinzima kakhulu umuntu ocindezelekile angayenza. Uma ucabanga ngakho - shaya ucingo. Umuntu ngakolunye uhlangothi ulungile.

signs.heading: Ukudangala kubukeka kanjani
signs.lede: Ukucindezeleka kubonakala kuhlukile kubantu abahlukene. Ezinye izimpawu zingokomzwelo, ezinye ngokomzimba, ezinye zezenhlalo. Amasonto amabili alezi zimpawu iningi losuku umkhawulo okufanele uthathwe ngokungathi sína.

items.title: Okungokomzwelo
items.description: Ukudabuka noma ukungabi nalutho okuqhubekayo, ukuphelelwa ithemba, ukuzizwa ungento yalutho noma unecala, ukucasuka noma intukuthelo (evame ukuphuthelwa amadoda), ukulahlekelwa isithakazelo ezintweni obukade uzijabulela.

items.title: Okomzimba
items.description: Ukukhathala okungalungiseki ubuthongo, ukushintsha kwesifiso sokudla (ngokuvamile ukudla kancane noma ngaphezulu kokujwayelekile), izinhlungu nezinhlungu, ukunyakaza okuhamba kancane noma ukukhuluma, ukuphazamiseka kokulala — kungaba kakhulu noma ukungakwazi ukulala.

items.title: Ezomphakathi nezokuqonda
items.description: Ukuhoxa kubangani nomndeni, ukuzabalaza ukwenza izinqumo noma ukugxilisa ingqondo, imicabango eqhubekayo yokuzilimaza noma ukufa. Le micabango ivamile ekucindezelekeni - kanye nesizathu sokufinyelela usizo, hhayi ukuhlukanisa okunye.

items.myth: Ukucindezeleka kuwubuthakathaka nje - kufanele ukwazi ukuzidonsa ndawonye.
items.fact: Ukucindezeleka yisimo sezokwelapha sangempela esihlanganisa izinguquko kumakhemikhali obuchopho. Ukutshela umuntu onokucindezeleka ukuthi 'aphume kukho' kufana nokutshela umuntu onesifo sikashukela ukuthi enze i-insulin ibe nzima. Akusebenzi futhi kuyabaphoxa.

items.myth: Ama-antidepressants ayalutha futhi ashintsha lokho oyikho.
items.fact: Ama-antidepressants esimanje awalutheki - nakuba kufanele ancishiswe kancane lapho eyeka. Ababushintshi ubuntu bakho. Basusa inkungu ukuze ube nguwe futhi.

Ukucindezeleka kwenzeka yonke indawo eMhlabeni, kuwo wonke amasiko, ngamanani afanayo. Indlela ezibonakalisa ngayo ingahluka (izimpawu eziningi zomzimba kwamanye amasiko), kodwa isimo esiyisisekelo sikhona yonke indawo - futhi siyelapheka.

items.myth: Ukukhuluma ngokuzibulala kwenza kube maningi amathuba okuthi kwenzeke.
items.fact: Okuphambene kuyiqiniso. Ukubuza ukuthi 'ingabe unemicabango yokuzibulala' kukhombisa ukunakekela futhi kudala isikhala sokuthola usizo. Ukuthula nokugwema yikho okwenza izinto zibe zimbi kakhulu.

items.title: Uma usebunzimeni — shayela i-SADAG manje
items.description: 0800 567 567 imahhala kunoma iyiphi ifoni, amahora angu-24. Abeluleki baqeqeshelwe ukulalela. Akudingekile ukuthi ube 'sebunzimeni ngokwanele' — vele uphendule.

items.title: Uma ukwazi - tshela umuntu oyedwa
items.description: Umngane, ilungu lomndeni, umholi wezenkolo, umphathi. Ukusho ngokuzwakalayo kanye kwephula okubi kakhulu kokuzihlukanisa. Awudingi ukukuchaza ngokuphelele.

items.title: Hamba uye emtholampilo uyohlolwa
items.description: Imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwezempilo yengqondo mahhala. Cela 'umhlengikazi wezempilo yengqondo' noma udokotela. Imithi elwa nokucindezeleka imahhala emitholampilo uma kudingeka.

items.title: Uma ukwazi ukuphatha izinto zansuku zonke
items.description: Thola ukukhanya kwelanga ekuseni, hamba uma ukwazi, udle ukudla okuncane okuvamile ngisho ungakuthandi ukudla, lala ngendlela evamile. Akukho kulokhu okwelapha ukudangala - kodwa kusiza ukwelashwa ukuthi kusebenze kangcono.

items.title: Uma umuntu omthandayo enokhwantalala
items.description: Lalela ngaphandle kokuzama ukulungisa. Ungasho ukuthi 'jabulani' noma 'abanye bakubi kakhulu'. Uthi 'ngikhona, ngiyakubona, yini engasiza'. Bakhuthaze ukuthi babize i-SADAG ndawonye.

get_help.heading: Ubani okumele ashayele khona manje
get_help.lede: INingizimu Afrika inokwesekwa kwamahhala, okuyimfihlo kwezempilo yengqondo okutholakala amahora angama-24 ngosuku. Awudingi i-medical aid, i-ID, noma ukudluliselwa. Ifoni nje.
